title: Check a grammar
description: Runs the grammar checker against the project's current Baseline and stores its findings; use warnings to read them afterward. The stored-analysis comparison follows the Default proposal checks setting unless the command overrides it. It returns the first 10 findings with the full counts and names the next offset; --limit, --offset, --page and --all read the rest; whole-grammar advisories (compose.whole-word-environment, compose.one-stem-inflection-class, grammar.orphan-environment) never change the exit code; multiReadingTypes counts the Assessment's word types that have more than one reading, grouped by morpheme pattern, and is report-only.
